FAQ

A little clarity
goes a long way.

01

What are the starting prices in AED and USD?

+

Studios start at AED 400,000 (about USD 108,918), one bedroom apartments at AED 800,000 (about USD 217,835), and two bedroom apartments at AED 1,350,000 (about USD 367,597). Prices are subject to availability and confirmation.

02

When is completion expected?

+

The expected handover is Q1 2029, as stated in the sales brief. The signed contract and official developer updates determine the applicable schedule.

03

Can I buy remotely with a passport?

+

You can begin the enquiry remotely. A passport is a starting document, but identity checks, source-of-funds information and other transaction documents may also be required. Confirm the remote signing or power-of-attorney process before booking.

04

Does buying a residence qualify me for a Golden Visa?

+

Not automatically. Real estate Golden Visa eligibility generally requires a qualifying total investment of at least AED 2 million and authority approval. The starting prices shown are below that threshold. Ask for an individual assessment, including the conditions for off-plan purchases.
